The organisation operates in the retail industry in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a GL Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Maintain accurate financial records and ensure transactions are recorded correctly.
• P&L analysis
• Preparing for financial audits
• Preparation of the monthly balance sheet
• Reconciliations
• Actins as point of contact with the banks
• Prepare and review journal entries to support reliable financial data.
• Check supporting documents to ensure complete and consistent accounting records.
• ...

A successful GL Accountant should have:

• Bachelor's degree in accounting & finance (or related field)
• 1 to 3 years' experience in accounting/finance
• Strong motivation, passion and ambition
• Fluency in French and Dutch, with a professional level of English
• Advanced Excel skills
• Experience with ERP systems
• Comfort working with finance colleagues on accounting matters.

What will you have to do?
 

 
• Learn how to prepare our extensive range of chocolates
 
• You’ll learn the recipes so you can perform all tasks independently
 
• You’ll keep your workstation tidy, because that’s how you prefer to work
 
• As a line operator, you’ll set up the machine according to the correct parameters and adjust them as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply the raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Converting machines is also part of your responsibilities, as is cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You have a degree as a chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef OR possess the necessary experience
 
• Recent graduates in the fields of chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef are also welcome
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:00 AM–1:00 PM / 1:00 PM–9:00 PM)
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are willing to undergo in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude
 
• You are a team player

To expand our Data & AI team at Cegeka, we are looking for a Data Migration Architect. Within our dynamic team of data experts, you too will play a crucial role in our challenging projects. Your passion is to bring together data from different sources and process them so that the data can be used for data analysis, visualization and data science. You will help our customers build scalable data architectures in Azure. Are you interested in joining our team of specialists? Then you can apply for this vacancy and let your talent and experience contribute to our mission!

• As a Data Migration Architect, you will work with the projectteam to ensure that our customers are guided through their migration process.
• You guide the customer in making choices regarding technical solutions and advise them on the right data infrastructure.
• You analyze existing data structures.
• You design and implement data migration strategies.
• You perform ETL-processes to migrate data from source systems to target systems.
• You ensure data integrity during the migration process.
• Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data migration.
• You optimize and document data migration processes for performance and efficiency.
• You stay updated with new data migration technologies and best practices.
• Your expertise also allows you to take the lead on the competence center around data migration.
What you need to succeed:
• You preferably have a relevant bachelor of master degree (Computer Science, Information Technology,…)
• You have several years of work experience as a Data Analyst or Business Analyst.You have strong analytical skills and common sense. 
• You have knowledge of SQL and Python and database systems such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, …
• You have knowledge of ETL processes and data integration techniques.
• You have experience in data validation, cleansing and testing for accuracy.
• You are familiar with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
• You have strong communication skills and enjoy working in a team.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English.
• You work according to a hybrid employment policy: from the Cegeka office near your place of residence (Ghent, Hasselt, Antwerp, or Leuven), combined with working from home and on site at the customer.

Do you enjoy working on the most innovative data solutions of the future? Then Cegeka has the challenge for you! Within our Data & AI team at Cegeka, we are looking for a Snowflake Platform Architect. As an expert in Snowflake, you will play a crucial role in our exciting Snowflake projects. We follow a “Public Cloud First” strategy and have established partnerships with Snowflake, Microsoft, and Databricks. Are you ready to join our team of specialists? Apply now and let your talent and experience contribute to our growth!

• As a Snowflake Platform Architect, you work with customers and colleagues to define the architecture and technical direction of enterprise data and AI platforms on Snowflake.
• You translate business, data, security and non-functional requirements into a future-proof platform architecture, including clear architecture principles, standards and roadmaps.
• You design scalable multi-account and multi-environment solutions and make well-founded choices regarding compute, storage, workload isolation, data lifecycle, network connectivity and disaster recovery.
• You define integration patterns for batch, streaming and data sharing, using technologies and concepts such as Snowpipe (Streaming), Snowflake Openflow / Apache NiFi, APIs, secure data sharing and Marketplace capabilities.
• You provide architectural direction for open lakehouse solutions with Apache Iceberg tables and catalogs such as Horizon Catalog and Snowflake Open Catalog/Polaris, with attention to interoperability across Azure and AWS.
• You design the governance and security model, using RBAC, masking and row access policies, tagging, auditing, private connectivity and compliance by design.
• You establish frameworks for platform automation and lifecycle management through Infrastructure as Code, Git and CI/CD, including Terraform, Snowflake CLI and automated quality controls.
• You safeguard performance, scalability and cost efficiency by defining standards for warehouse sizing, resource monitors, query profiling, observability and FinOps.
• You guide Data Engineers and other specialists through complex technical decisions, conduct architecture reviews and act as a trusted technical point of contact for customers, Cegeka teams and Snowflake solution architects.
What you need to succeed:
• You have extensive experience as a Data Platform Architect, Cloud Data Architect, Snowflake Architect or in a comparable senior role within complex enterprise environments.
• You have proven experience designing and implementing Snowflake platform architectures, including account strategy, environment separation, workload isolation, scalability and high availability.
• You combine strong hands-on Snowflake knowledge with in-depth expertise in SQL, platform configuration and relevant automation; knowledge of Python and Snowpark is an asset.
• You are familiar with data integration and orchestration patterns using Snowpipe (Streaming), Snowflake Openflow / Apache NiFi, Airflow, Snowflake Tasks, Streams and Dynamic Tables.
• You have experience with open lakehouse architectures, Apache Iceberg tables and catalog integrations such as Horizon Catalog, Snowflake Open Catalog/Polaris, AWS Glue or Unity Catalog.
• You have a strong background in cloud architecture on Azure and/or AWS, including storage integrations, external volumes, private connectivity, identity federation and network security.
• You master Snowflake security and governance, including RBAC, masking and row access policies, tagging, auditing, data sharing and compliance by design.
• You have experience with Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD, preferably Terraform, Git and Snowflake CLI, and can define standards for controlled deployments and platform lifecycle management.
• You can substantiate architecture decisions relating to performance, capacity and cost, using warehouse sizing, resource monitors, query profiling, observability and FinOps principles.
• You are familiar with enterprise data modelling and operating models such as Data Vault, Kimball and data mesh, and can translate them into clear platform guidelines.
• You work according to a hybrid employment policy: from the Cegeka office near your place of residence (Ghent, Brussels, Hasselt, Antwerp or Leuven), combined with working from home and on site at the customer.
• Nice to have: SnowPro Core and/or SnowPro Advanced: Architect, complemented by relevant Azure or AWS certifications.
• You have strong stakeholder management and communication skills and can explain complex architecture clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. You are fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and French is a strong asset.

Your role
Did you know that the solutions we develop are a key part of most industries? Electronics, medical research, renewable energy, food production, infrastructure and many more.

We´re everywhere! Working with us means working with the latest technologies and groundbreaking, sustainable innovations. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow.

In this role, you will design and build a secure, reusable code base as well as data assets and pipelines (ETL/ELT). Together with the product team, you will take ownership of end-to-end data products by defining their purpose, roadmap, and delivery. You will also advise on data model design and overall architecture, ensuring robust and scalable solutions. Additionally, you will collaborate closely with stakeholders and the product team to deliver actionable data solutions with various outputs (dashboards, API's, Intelligent agents, toolboxes, leads and more) with a focus on our global logistics organization.

To succeed, you will need
At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.

• Degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or equivalent experience
• Fluent in English, both oral and written
• 3–6 years of experience in data engineering, with strong skills in SQL, Python, and data modelling
• Experience with BI principles, dimensional modelling, and data visualization is a plus
• Familiarity with cloud data platforms and documentation practices, with knowledge of Azure tools (e.g., Databricks) considered a plus
• Interest in modern technologies and industrial data contexts, along with an understanding of agile methodologies or product ownership principles

Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain software applications using modern development frameworks.
• Translate functional requirements into technical specifications and validate them with key stakeholders.
• Provide second-level technical support by analyzing and resolving complex software defects.
• Implement automation and continuous integration through pipelines and unit testing to ensure environment stability.
• Collaborate within a multidisciplined team following the SAFe framework to deliver incremental value.

Requirements

• 3+ years backend development with C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework.
• 1+ years web development using Blazor and REST APIs.
• 1+ years data and integration experience with SQL and NServiceBus.
• 1+ years experience in Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
• You possess experience with Unit Testing and Agile/SAFe methodologies.
• You're proactive with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• You bring a collaborative mindset and are able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Destelbergen.Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit? 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence.

• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.Working hours are from Monday to Friday in a two-shift system: 
• Morning shift: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM 
• Afternoon shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You perform well in a team and communicate effectively with colleagues. 
• You are stress-resistant and thrive in a production environment where pace is important. 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

A packed schedule, a hundred things happening at once and always something that needs sorting out. Sound familiar?
  
Some people find that stressful. You actually thrive on it!
  
As Management & Personal Assistant, you'll become a trusted right hand to management, providing both professional and personal support.
  
But here's what really makes the difference: you don't just get things started, you make sure they're properly taken care of, right down to the smallest detail. 
  
You'll be trusted to take ownership, anticipate needs and find solutions independently, without constant reminders or follow-ups.
  
The goal? To give management the peace of mind that when something is in your hands, it's taken care of.
  
No two days are quite the same. And that's exactly what makes this role so interesting!
  
Your responsibilities cover two main areas.
  
Management Support – Making things happen behind the scenes
    
• You manage inboxes, calendars and daily communications, ensuring everything is followed up efficiently.  
• You organise and prepare meetings, appointments and discussions.  
• You gather information, bring structure and create clear, practical overviews.  
• You keep track of deadlines, action points and ongoing projects.  
• You provide administrative and organisational support across various management responsibilities, including sales and HR.  
• You liaise with colleagues, suppliers and external partners.  
• You assist with the practical organisation of business trips, trade fairs, reservations and events.  
• When management is away, you keep things moving. You follow up on important matters, handle what you can independently and provide a clear overview upon their return.   
Personal & Household Management – Making life easier!
  
Beyond business support, you'll also help keep the personal lives of the management team running smoothly.
  
This isn't a housekeeping position. It's about coordinating, organising and taking care of practical matters that make everyday life easier.
    
• You coordinate external household help and manage the related planning and communication.  
• You arrange home maintenance, repairs, deliveries and appointments.  
• You handle practical errands and purchases for both the company and private needs.  
• You manage orders, parcels, deliveries and returns.  
• You organise gifts, flowers and thoughtful gestures.  
• You research and coordinate private travel, appointments and reservations.  
• You take care of practical arrangements involving vehicles, servicing and other everyday matters.   
And sometimes, something unexpected simply needs sorting out.
  
No problem. You focus on solutions, not obstacles!

An impressive CV? Great! But for this position, who you are and how you work matter just as much as what you've already accomplished.
  
We're looking for someone who's naturally organised. Not because they've learned to be, but because it's simply part of who they are. Someone who notices the little things, thinks ahead and genuinely enjoys bringing order to a busy day.
  
Does this sound like you?
    
• Organisation is second nature to you. You love structure, have an exceptional eye for detail and never lose sight of the bigger picture.  
• You're always thinking a few steps ahead. You spot what needs doing, take initiative and don't wait for instructions.  
• You take real ownership. When something is entrusted to you, others can count on it being handled from start to finish, without having to double-check.  
• Discretion comes naturally. You're trustworthy, reliable and understand the importance of confidentiality when professional and personal matters overlap.  
• You're hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented. You switch easily between different responsibilities and stay calm when unexpected situations arise.  
• You're a confident communicator and digitally savvy. You communicate clearly, feel comfortable with digital tools and adapt easily to different situations.  
• You genuinely enjoy making life easier for others. Knowing that someone can stop worrying about something because you've taken care of it? That's what motivates you!   
What else do you bring?
    
• A bachelor's degree and ideally some initial experience in an administrative, organisational or support role.  
• Previous experience in a similar position is a definite advantage, but the right attitude, maturity and potential to grow into the role are just as valuable.  
• Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken, ideally together with good written French.  
• A valid category B driving licence.   
And the right personal fit? That's just as important to us.
  
You feel at home in a dynamic, informal environment with a relatively young team. You're positive, engaged and bring a healthy dose of common sense.
  
Ultimately, we're looking for someone management can turn to and say: "Could you take care of this?" And know it's in good hands.

jobs.occupation: Senior Key Account Manager / Business Development Manager Biometrics
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
   
• Identify, develop and win new strategic accounts within the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry, building relationships from initial prospecting through to contract award.  
• Own and develop a portfolio of key accounts, establishing account strategies, identifying growth opportunities and increasing share of wallet.  
• Build and maintain strong, multi-level relationships with key decision-makers, including Clinical Operations, Biometrics, Data Management, Statistics, Procurement and R&D stakeholders.  
• Develop a deep understanding of customer strategies, pipelines and outsourcing models to anticipate needs and position relevant SGS solutions proactively.  
• Drive new opportunities and expansion within existing accounts,  
• Lead strategic customer engagements, RFPs, negotiations and commercial discussions through to successful contract closure.  
• Develop and execute account plans and business development strategies, including target identification, opportunity qualification, pipeline development and revenue forecasting.  
• Actively build your network through industry events, conferences, professional networks and targeted business development activities.  
• Work closely with internal Clinical Research, Biometrics and commercial teams to develop tailored solutions and competitive value propositions.  
• Act as the voice of the customer internally, ensuring customer priorities are understood and reflected in proposals, delivery models and commercial strategies.  
• Establish strong internal stakeholder relationships and coordinate cross-functional teams around strategic opportunities and key accounts.  
• Maintain a high level of market intelligence, including competitor activity, outsourcing trends, pricing and customer priorities.  
• Ensure accurate and proactive management of opportunities, account plans and customer intelligence in the CRM system.  
• Contribute to the development of the Biometrics commercial strategy and identify new market segments, services and partnership opportunities. 

Your profile
   
• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in Life Sciences, Business or an equivalent field.  
• You have 8+ years of relevant commercial experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research or CRO industry, ideally combining new business development and strategic account management.  
• You have a proven track record of winning new business and growing strategic accounts, preferably within CRO, Biometrics, Data Management, Biostatistics or related clinical development services.  
• You have a strong understanding of the clinical drug development process and the role of Biometrics throughout clinical development.  
• You are commercially driven and comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders across Clinical Operations, Biometrics, R&D, Procurement and executive management.  
• You have demonstrated experience managing complex sales cycles, strategic RFPs, negotiations and multi-stakeholder decision processes.  
• You are a strong hunter and relationship builder, able to open new accounts while developing long-term strategic partnerships.  
• You combine a strategic mindset with a hands-on approach to prospecting, opportunity development and account execution.  
• You are highly networked within the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry and comfortable representing the organization at conferences and industry events.  
• You have excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.  
• You are fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry in Zottegem, is currently looking for a motivated operator to join the packaging department in a 2 shift system.What will your responsibilities be?As a packaging operator, you are an essential link in our client’s production process.Multitasking, precision and working at a fast pace are your strengths.Your responsibilities: 
• You will mainly be responsible for packaging the finished products. 
• You will regularly carry out quality checks. 
• You will ensure that packaging materials are supplied to the production line. 
• You will set up your machine and keep it running smoothly. 
• Labelling and logistical tasks will also be part of your responsibilities. 
• Finally, you will ensure a clean and tidy working environment.The working hours are from Monday till Friday in a 2 shiftsystem:early shift: 06:00–14:00late shift: 14:00–22:00
 
• You have some previous experience in a production environment, preferably in the food industry. 
• You are available to start soon. 
• You speak Dutch and/or English fluently. 
• You are conscientious and enjoy working efficiently. 
• You are an excellent multitasker. 
• You can work well both independently and as part of a team. 
• Working at a fast pace is not a problem for you. 
• You are enthusiastic and eager to learn. 
• You are specifically looking for a job in 2 shifts. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.
